title: nexpose-brute
author: Vlatko Kosturjak
description: Performs brute force password auditing against a Nexpose vulnerability scanner using the API 1.1. As the Nexpose application enforces account lockout after 4 incorrect login attempts, the script performs only 3 guesses per default. This can be altered by supplying the brute.guesses argument a different value or 0 (zero) to guess the whole dictionary.
